scheme_name: Scholarship for Children of Deceased/Disabled/Retired Government Employees
other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh.
Must be studying in a government school in Madhya Pradesh.
Must be a child of a deceased, disabled, or retired government employee.
Must not be a beneficiary of any other scholarship.
Must have passed the previous class.
benefits_summary: Scholarships of ₹50 per year for classes 1‑5, ₹120 for classes 6‑8, and ₹250 for classes 9‑12 are provided to eligible students.
